_regions.R: body red: crown, nape, cheek, breast, belly, undertail coverts; the red pixel at [12,3] bites into the white face where the red feather lines are densest
_regions.r: dark red lesser coverts along the wing's shoulder edge
_regions.T: tail, upper (lit) side of the long central feathers
_regions.B: blue flight feathers (secondaries/primaries), wing tip below the perch
_regions.W: bare white facial skin (the eye sits alone inside it)
_regions.U: pale horn upper mandible, hooked; tip at beak_tip
_regions.K: dark lower mandible (black in life, slate here so it never reads black-on-black); x14 rows 4-5, under the white face and behind the pale hook
_regions.E: eye (1 px, inside the white face)
_regions.P: perch (optional; drop the letter to float the bird)
